anchors.text: Approved deployment responsibility: Gateway validates ingress and forwards approved traffic to Worker.
Approved deployment responsibility: Worker executes the release workload after Gateway validation.
Approved deployment responsibility: Audit Store records the immutable release audit event from Worker.
Incident Commander owns the incident decision lane and assigns the response priority.
Communications Lead owns stakeholder updates and receives the Commander handoff.
Escalate an unresolved severity-one incident to the Incident Commander within 15 minutes.
The Archive node retention period is seven years. The record must state Retention: 7 years.
Review must approve Release using a two-person approval control.
The required control identifier for the Review to Release relationship is PC-204.
Version 3 segmentation requires Public Zone to Private Zone traffic to pass through the Quarantine Path.
Use the canonical English service names API Gateway, Billing Worker, and Audit Store. Ownership is Platform Team, Payments Team, and Governance Team respectively.
The change calendar assigns Database Change to DBA Owner and Application Change to Application Owner.
Both changes require the approval window Tue 10:00–12:00.
Selected warehouse figure: Intake goes to Inspect; an exception goes to Supervisor Review; a cleared item goes to Dispatch.
Scanned field handoff: Field Technician records the handoff, Decision: complete?, No returns to Field Technician, Yes goes to Operations Lead.
The cited Release Gate rollback condition is: rollback to the prior stable version when post-release verification fails.
The documented steady-state capacity limit is 800 requests per second.
The documented failover capacity limit is 1200 requests per second.
Incident Commander owns the incident decision lane and assigns the response priority.
Communications Lead receives the Incident Commander handoff and owns stakeholder updates.
